title: CENTCOM Statement on Operations in Iran
summary: CENTCOM confirmed precision strikes on IRGC command and control facilities, missile storage sites, and naval headquarters. Statement emphasized 'defensive operations in response to Iranian aggression.'
quote: US Central Command conducted precision strikes against IRGC Quds Force command facilities, missile storage sites, and naval headquarters to degrade the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' ability to conduct offensive operations against US forces and allies in the region.

title: IRGC Statement on Retaliatory Operations
summary: IRGC announced successful drone strikes on Ali Al Salem Air Base (Kuwait), Sheikh Isa Air Base (Bahrain), and Amazon data center facilities. Claimed destruction of ammunition depots and multiple hangars.
quote: In response to continued American aggression against the Islamic Republic, the IRGC Aerospace Force conducted successful operations against US military installations in Kuwait and Bahrain. A very large ammunition depot at Ali Al Salem Air Base was completely destroyed using advanced OWA drones. Six large barracks hangars were struck, with confirmed casualties among American forces.

title: IRGC Navy Statement on Zibakenar HQ Strike
summary: IRGC confirmed that its Hazrat Seyyed al-Shohada headquarters in Zibakenar, Gilan province was struck by US standoff munitions. No high-value casualties confirmed. Portrayed as a propaganda victory.
quote: The Hazrat Seyyed al-Shohada headquarters of the IRGC Navy in Zibakenar came under attack by American standoff weapons. Despite the strike, the command and control capabilities of the IRGC Navy remain fully operational. The enemy's attempt to decapitate our naval command has failed.

title: 5th Fleet Statement on Maritime Interdiction
summary: US 5th Fleet announced prevention of 12 ships from transiting the Strait of Hormuz as part of ongoing blockade operations. Vessels suspected of carrying military supplies for IRGC forces.
quote: US Naval Forces Central Command prevented 12 vessels from transiting the Strait of Hormuz in the past 24 hours. These operations are part of ongoing efforts to interdict the flow of weapons and military material to Iranian proxy forces across the region.

title: Artesh Statement on Retaliatory Strikes
summary: Iranian Army (Artesh) announced coordinated strikes with Arash drones on US military infrastructure across Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait. Targeted fuel storage, hangars, equipment warehouses, and barracks.
quote: The Islamic Republic of Iran Army conducted coordinated precision strikes against US military infrastructure in Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait. Targets included fuel storage facilities, aircraft hangars, maintenance facilities, and equipment warehouses at Sheikh Isa Air Base, Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base, Camp Buehring, Camp Doha, and Camp Arifjan.

title: Pentagon Statement on Strike on Natanz
summary: Pentagon confirmed drone strike on Natanz enrichment facility perimeter, attributing it to 'precision operations to prevent Iranian nuclear breakout capability.' Iran claimed 3 of 4 drones intercepted.
quote: US forces conducted a precision operation against the Natanz enrichment facility in Iran to prevent the regime from advancing its nuclear program toward weaponization capability. Initial assessments indicate the operation successfully degraded Iran's centrifuge infrastructure.

title: IRGC Statement on Natanz Air Defense
summary: IRGC claimed air defenses successfully intercepted 3 of 4 UAVs targeting Natanz. Admitted structural damage to centrifuge hall annex. Accused US of 'nuclear terrorism.'
quote: The cowardly drone attack on the Natanz enrichment site was met with a swift response from IRGC Air Defense units. Three of four enemy UAVs were intercepted before reaching their targets. The fourth caused minor structural damage to an auxiliary building. This act of nuclear terrorism will not go unanswered.

title: CENTCOM Statement on Bandar Abbas Strike
summary: CENTOM confirmed Tomahawk cruise missile strike on IRGC Navy headquarters in Bandar Abbas. Described as 'precision strike on legitimate military target.'
quote: US Navy forces conducted a precision Tomahawk land attack missile strike on the IRGC Navy headquarters complex in Bandar Abbas. The facility served as a command and control node for IRGC naval operations and intelligence gathering against US forces in the Persian Gulf.

title: IRGC Condemns Bandar Abbas Strike
summary: IRGC confirmed destruction of Bandar Abbas headquarters, claiming 22 military and 3 civilian casualties. Warned of 'severe retaliation.' Accused US of war crimes.
quote: The American regime's missile attack on the IRGC Navy headquarters in Bandar Abbas resulted in the martyrdom of 22 of our brave officers and injury to 3 civilians in the surrounding area. This criminal act will be met with proportionate and severe retaliation. The blood of our martyrs will only strengthen our resolve.

title: Pentagon Statement on Bushehr Strike
summary: Pentagon confirmed B-2 Spirit bombers struck underground missile storage facilities east of Bushehr. Described as 'one of the most significant strikes of the campaign.'
quote: US Air Force B-2 Spirit stealth bombers conducted a precision strike on underground IRGC missile storage and launch facilities approximately 40 kilometers east of Bushehr. Secondary explosions indicate successful targeting of stored munitions. This operation significantly degrades Iran's ability to conduct long-range missile attacks.

title: IRGC Confirms Bushehr Missile Site Destruction
summary: IRGC confirmed destruction of missile storage facilities near Bushehr. 18 IRGC personnel killed, 1 civilian casualty. Vowed to continue missile operations.
quote: The enemy's strikes on our missile storage facilities southeast of Bushehr have caused damage and resulted in the loss of 18 of our forces. Despite these attacks, the IRGC's missile capabilities remain largely intact and our offensive operations will continue. The enemy's assessment of the damage is exaggerated.

sourceLabel: Khatam al-Anbiya Central HQ — Maj Gen Abdollahi
title: Proportional Retaliation Doctrine: One Iranian = One American
summary: Khatam al Anbiya commander officially declared new battlefield equation: for every Iranian citizen martyred, one US servicemember will be killed.
quote: The principle that we had previously demonstrated to the enemy as operational is, from this moment onward, the definitive and officially declared equation of the battlefield: for every proud citizen of the Islamic Republic of Iran who is martyred, one american servicemember will be sent to hell. We have prepared free, one way tickets straight to hell for you.

title: CENTCOM Confirms Naval Blockade — 12 Ships Prevented
summary: CENTCOM confirmed maritime interdiction operations preventing 12 vessels from transiting Strait of Hormuz.
quote: US Naval Forces Central Command prevented 12 vessels from transiting the Strait of Hormuz in the past 24 hours as part of ongoing blockade operations to interdict the flow of weapons and military material to Iranian proxy forces.

title: Trump Refuses to Answer War Crime Question on Civilian Bombing
summary: Trump refused to answer whether bombing civilian power plants in Iran constitutes a war crime. Removed from press conference.
quote: Reporter: "You are talking about bombing civilian power plants and bridges in Iran. Much of the civilized world considers this a war crime. Do you consider it a war crime?" Trump: "I'm not answering that question. Which media outlet are you with?" Reporter: "The New York Times." Trump: "I thought so. The failing New York Times!"

title: Araqchi: Insecurity in Strait of Hormuz Caused by US Violations
summary: Iranian FM Araqchi condemned US attacks on civilian infrastructure as war crimes during calls with Chinese and Russian counterparts.
quote: Araqchi stressed during meetings with Chinese and Russian counterparts that insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz is caused by America's violation of its commitments. Condemned brutal attacks on Iran's vital infrastructure and the commission of war crimes. Emphasized Iran's determination to defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

title: NYT: Iranian Proxies Planned to Target Trump at NATO Summit
summary: Credible intelligence threat indicated Iranian proxy forces planned to target President Trump and Air Force One during NATO summit in Turkey.
quote: A credible intelligence threat indicated that Iranian proxy forces were planning to target President Trump and the presidential plane during the NATO summit in Turkey in early July. The Secret Service recommended changing the presidential plane that transported him on the return flight.

title: IRIAF Deploys F-14 Tomcats and MiG-29s for Homeland Defense
summary: Iranian Air Force deployed F-14 Tomcats along Iraq border and MiG-29s covering major cities.
quote: Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force F-14 Tomcats are conducting patrol operations near the northern Iran-Iraq border. MiG-29s reported covering major cities in defensive posture.

title: Large US Fighter Formation Over Jordan — Air Operations Preparing
summary: Large formation of fighter jets over Jordan with E-11 BACN aircraft positioning, signaling imminent strikes.
quote: Large formation of fighter jets currently over Jordan. E-11 Battlefield Airborne Communications Node (BACN) aircraft out of Prince Sultan Air Base getting into position.

title: Hezbollah Announces Resumption of Operations Against Israel
summary: Hezbollah resumed cross-border attacks into northern Israel in response to Khamenei killing and US-Israeli strikes on Iran.
quote: This is a defensive act after over a year of Israeli attacks despite a truce. We restarted fighting to force Israel to stop its aggression and evacuate from seized Lebanese territories. The move is unrelated to the Iran war.

title: IRGC Commander in Lebanon Killed - Hezbollah Communications Unit Hit
summary: IDF killed an IRGC commander serving in both Hezbollah communications unit and Quds Force Palestine Corps.
quote: The IDF killed an IRGC commander in Lebanon who was both a member of Hezbollah communications unit and the Quds Force Palestine Corps.

title: Operation Eternal Darkness - IDF Confirms Coordinated Lebanon Strikes
summary: IDF launched Operation Eternal Darkness across Lebanon, striking 89 targets. Working assumption: fighting with Iran will resume.
quote: We launched Operation Eternal Darkness in Lebanon. Our working assumption is that fighting with Iran will resume. Hezbollah launched 35 waves of attacks.
